Ventoy 1.1.16 in Vendroid
=========================

Vendroid writes boot files from the official Ventoy 1.1.16 Linux release to
your USB drive: boot/boot.img, boot/core.img.xz and ventoy/ventoy.disk.img.xz.
Vendroid does not modify them. Vendroid is not affiliated with the Ventoy
project.

Release: https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/releases/tag/v1.1.16


Licenses
--------

Ventoy is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or
later. Its boot files also contain other free software, including GRUB 2,
iPXE, wimboot, memdisk, BusyBox, EDK II, efifs, shim and MokManager, and
ImDisk.

The License folder beside this notice is an unmodified copy of the License
folder in the Ventoy source tree at the commit below. It holds the license
texts and the terms Ventoy states for each component. Start with
license-ventoy.txt, gpl-3.0.txt and gpl-2.0.txt.

These programs come with NO WARRANTY, to the extent permitted by law. See
sections 15 and 16 of gpl-3.0.txt.


Corresponding source
--------------------

The complete source of Ventoy 1.1.16 is this tag and commit of the Ventoy
repository:

  Tag:     https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/tree/v1.1.16
  Commit:  https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/commit/2f66a309e4a3f0e08953aabfb0f1cf7e12b39f5d
  Archive: https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/archive/refs/tags/v1.1.16.tar.gz

Every Vendroid release on GitHub also carries a copy of that archive as
ventoy-1.1.16-source.tar.gz, with this License folder and a checksum list:

  https://github.com/xntsO/Vendroid/releases


BusyBox
-------

Ventoy's boot files contain BusyBox programs. BusyBox is under the GNU
General Public License, version 2 (gpl-2.0.txt). Ventoy uses BusyBox
unmodified and keeps only its binaries and build settings in the repository
above, so the BusyBox source is separate. The binaries come from these
upstream versions:

  https://busybox.net/downloads/busybox-1.27.1.tar.bz2
  https://busybox.net/downloads/busybox-1.28.1.tar.bz2
  https://busybox.net/downloads/busybox-1.30.0.tar.bz2
  https://busybox.net/downloads/busybox-1.31.0.tar.bz2
  https://busybox.net/downloads/busybox-1.32.0.tar.bz2

Every Vendroid release on GitHub carries a copy of these five archives too.


Versions downloaded in the app
------------------------------

The optional online update downloads a newer official Ventoy release through
Vendroid's mirror. The source of a downloaded version is the tag with the
same number in the Ventoy repository, for example
https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/tree/v1.1.18 for Ventoy 1.1.18. The mirror
lists its own copy of that source at:

  https://updates.vendroid.fhas.sa/v1/ventoy/source/<version>.json


Questions about these notices or a source request: contact@fhas.sa
